mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Whole image; actual 1086×1448, ratio 3:4; one poster, no panels or mockup.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: All 14 required copy items and all operational clauses
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: copy_check items 1–14; 720px rows y662–826 include exclusion, parts cost, completion limitation, consent.
mandatory_conditions.observation: All item content read manually in native and 720 views; separator spacing issue retained at item 8.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Application deadline December 2 and full haram-mend.example/join easy to find
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Single large red row near bottom, 720 y882–911, native y1329–1371.
mandatory_conditions.observation: Deadline and full URL read; URL fits within the right margin without clipping. Character proportions appear normal enough to read in this view; no actual font width specification can be proved.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Small glasses hinge repair with visible screw head and screwdriver contact
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Photo center, native approximately x609–670 y395–456; 720 approximately x404–444 y262–302.
mandatory_conditions.observation: Eyeglass frame, open temple, metal hinge and screw-like head are visible. Driver tip reaches the head; axis/seating plausibility remains uncertain.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: New photographic relationship with title/information alignment, no wood box or vertical left photo/full-height right guide
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Whole composition: upper photograph spans page width, aligned title above; broad lower information field.
mandatory_conditions.observation: Requested alternative scene and spatial relationship are visible. No prior or peer output was used for comparison.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: No electronics, dangerous items, tool pile or added copy
mandatory_conditions.observation: One eyeglass pair and one screwdriver; no electronics, hands, other tools or invented subhead/logo seen.

reading_structure_observations.native_and_720: Large title and subtitle precede the photograph; date/time/place are a larger group below photo; audience and four operating conditions are smaller shared-width lines; fee has separate spacing; red application row is distinctly emphasized; contact is final. Longest condition fits one line at 720 and was readable without enlarging the QA file.
reading_structure_observations.320: Title is first prominent element, then close eyeglass image and bold date; red deadline/URL row remains conspicuous. The small clause block is visibly denser and is not reliably fully readable at this thumbnail size.
reading_structure_observations.alignment: Main title, subtitle and lower rows share a left margin. The screwdriver diagonal visibly moves toward the hinge; its axis does not literally continue as an information baseline, so the planned relation is only partly rendered.

glyph_observations.hangul: No unmistakable malformed syllable was identified in the native and 720 reading; this is a visual observation, not a proof that every raster glyph matches a named font.
glyph_observations.punctuation: Time range, colons, middle dots, comma in 5,000 and URL punctuation are visible. Item 8 has wider apparent spacing around the middle dot than the raw supplied copy.
glyph_observations.clipping_and_duplicates: No clipped, duplicated, missing or additional text item identified during this manual read.

material_observations.region: Lens and rim, left half of photo
material_observations.evidence: Clear lens has a bright curved edge reflection; work surface is visible through it with soft transmitted/reflected patches. Dark acetate rim has amber translucent edge areas and stronger narrow highlights on curves.
material_observations.uncertainty: Some lens interior looks diffuse/hazy; image alone cannot separate lens reflection, shallow focus and generated haze.

material_observations.evidence: Small bright metal faces carry directional highlights and irregular localized marks, differing from smoother acetate. The head/washer-like top and hinge body have distinct edges.
material_observations.uncertainty: Hinge is somewhat chunky relative to eyeglass frame; exact functional construction is not established.

material_observations.region: Screwdriver shaft and handle, upper right
material_observations.evidence: Long narrow steel shaft alternates light/dark reflections; knurled handle is cut by upper/right boundary.
material_observations.uncertainty: Tip reaches the apparent head, but oblique shaft versus screw-head normal makes actual slot seating and a usable torque axis uncertain.

material_observations.region: Cool gray work surface and out-of-focus areas
material_observations.evidence: Foreground surface below lens contains fine granular mottling. Upper/distant background is softer and less textured; acetate and shaft do not carry the same blanket grain. Contact shadows occur beneath frame/temple.
material_observations.uncertainty: Fine stippling remains visible on the tabletop and through the lens at native scale; cannot certify that its scale/light behavior is completely natural.

remaining_issues.visible_evidence: Item 8 visually reads 전기 · 배터리 rather than the tight source 전기·배터리.
remaining_issues.impact: Literal raw-copy spacing cannot be certified as preserved.
remaining_issues.possible_followup: If coordinator assigns a correction, require the no-space electrical/battery separator while preserving full 14-item copy.

remaining_issues.visible_evidence: Driver tip apparently touches head, but shaft is diagonally inclined relative to top-facing head.
remaining_issues.impact: Repair scene reads, yet true mechanical engagement is not securely demonstrated.
remaining_issues.possible_followup: If coordinator assigns a correction, clarify slot engagement and driver/screw axis with same eyeglass scene and copy.

remaining_issues.visible_evidence: Foreground gray surface is finely granular and lens interior somewhat diffuse; hinge appears thick for small eyewear.
remaining_issues.impact: Native material/structure finish needs independent review; cannot self-certify photographic realism.
remaining_issues.possible_followup: Independent material review before selecting any bounded correction.

remaining_issues.visible_evidence: Upper photographic field and lower text field use an abrupt horizontal boundary; driver diagonal ends at hinge instead of directly organizing the lower baseline.
remaining_issues.impact: Shared left alignment and the subject connection are present, but the image-to-information transition remains conventional.
remaining_issues.possible_followup: Coordinator may assess whether the retained spatial relationship satisfies the assigned direction.

source_scope.postprocessing: Byte copies only for original/final; Pillow used only for 720px-width and 320px-long-side reductions.

qualification: This is a maker inspection with retained defects and uncertainty, not visual-quality certification, independent evaluation, font verification or a maximum-resolution guarantee.
